During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent [[Theron Shan]] and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military's]] [[Reaver Station]].
